rules: metadata absence => absent_from_accessible_metadata, not proven unimplemented
read success => limited current read observation only; empty rows do not prove global/all-row read rights
separate schema, metadata publication, observed operation evidence and local READ_ONLY/writable flags
dynamic inputs and conditional dependencies must be resolved for invocation; optional misses cannot blanket-block independent feature
functions and result fields may not be declared on register root entity; preserve unknown until safe operation evidence
proven maintenance/network/5xx errors are availability evidence, not rights denial
404 record read => record missing/unknown; not absent collection
old observed write evidence needs timestamp/TTL and endpoint+principal scope; no blanket permanent authorization
new versioned requirements should create newly-required drift entries even if no old tool/requirement existed
